name: Starter Skills
description: Three hand-written starter skills in the Agent Skills (SKILL.md) format — code review, data analysis, and web research — as short inline playbooks. Enable the plugin, then turn a skill on for a conversation from the composer's skill picker (type @skill:). /skill lists them.
author: cognia-next

commands.name: /skill
commands.description: List the starter skills and how to turn one on.

en.manifest.name: Starter Skills
en.manifest.description: Three hand-written starter skills in the Agent Skills (SKILL.md) format — code review, data analysis, and web research — as short inline playbooks. Enable the plugin, then turn a skill on for a conversation from the composer's skill picker (type @skill:). /skill lists them.
en.skill.title: Starter skills
en.skill.intro: These playbooks come with the Starter Skills plugin:
en.skill.howTo: To use one, type `@skill:` in the chat composer (or open the composer's skill picker) and pick it. It stays on for this conversation.
en.skill.codeReview.name: Code Review
en.skill.codeReview.description: Review a diff or files for bugs, security issues, and missing tests, with file:line findings and suggested fixes.
en.skill.dataAnalysis.name: Data Analysis
en.skill.dataAnalysis.description: Inspect tabular data, check quality, and report statistics with stated uncertainty.
en.skill.webResearch.name: Web Research
en.skill.webResearch.description: Research a topic from primary sources, cross-check claims, and cite URLs.
en.commands.skill.description: List the starter skills and how to turn one on.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 入门技能
zh-CN.manifest.description: 三个按 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）格式手写的入门技能——代码审查、数据分析、网页调研——均为简短的内联操作手册。启用插件后，在输入框的技能选择器（输入 @skill:）中为对话开启技能；/skill 可列出它们。
zh-CN.skill.title: 入门技能
zh-CN.skill.intro: 「入门技能」插件提供以下技能手册：
zh-CN.skill.howTo: 使用方法：在聊天输入框中输入 `@skill:`（或打开输入框的技能选择器）并选中它，该技能会在本次对话中保持开启。
zh-CN.skill.codeReview.name: 代码审查
zh-CN.skill.codeReview.description: 审查 diff 或文件中的缺陷、安全问题与缺失的测试，按 文件:行号 给出问题和修复建议。
zh-CN.skill.dataAnalysis.name: 数据分析
zh-CN.skill.dataAnalysis.description: 检查表格数据的结构与质量，并给出带不确定性说明的统计结论。
zh-CN.skill.webResearch.name: 网络调研
zh-CN.skill.webResearch.description: 基于一手来源调研主题，交叉核对结论并附上来源链接。
zh-CN.commands.skill.description: 列出入门技能，并说明如何启用。
